concepts.gloss_en: Shifra — the midwife (Exod. 1), invoked in the context of birth/holada and the flow (shefa) of supernal pleasantness

members.note: representative; used in lm2:71 re birth/tikkun of mochin

concepts.gloss_en: Para — 'cow', here homiletically equated with prayer (tefillah)

members.note: representative; lm1:55 'פרה זהו בחינת תפילה' — entirely different word/root from שפרה

notes: The mechanical 'he+clitic' signal is a false positive: שפרה (Shifra, proper name) and פרה (cow) are unrelated lexemes with different referents and appear in different Torahs. Do not merge.
